name: cursor-relay-mcp
description: Durable, model-selected Cursor Agent delegation through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate durable tasks to a chosen Cursor model.
interface.longDescription: Discover account models and delegate local workspace tasks to Cursor Agent with durable history, workspace SQLite, execution uncertainty reporting, bounded events, and progress links.
defaultPrompt: Pass workspace, locations and scope, never source text. Cursor reads authorized files. Keep 24h runs and share open_run links.
